timeline.label: FDA posts the penicillin g potassium shortage
FDA inspection 1208260 ended 2023-06-16, classified VAI; classification letter 2024-09-10

explanation.headline: FDA's records show the shortage has been listed for 42 months and the labeled plant for our product was last inspected 51 days after the posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the penicillin G benzathine injection shortage on 2023-04-26 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage has been on FDA's list for 42 months as of today.
Our product label names Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189) as the plant.
FDA inspection 1208260 at that plant ended 2023-06-16 with a VAI classification, and the classification letter was issued 2024-09-10 — 51 days after the shortage posting.
Corvale East and Corvale General each have 18 days of supply on hand at current usage rates.
The rule-selected alternate manufacturer is A-S Medication Solutions, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
Buyer should verify availability and sourcing for A-S Medication Solutions and monitor FDA updates for Pfizer's estimated recovery in 4Q 2027.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-2a0ef8.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%penicillin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%penicillin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-4e84eb.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('efef4846-9497-41af-8dd6-518f86eca7f2', '91950983-4884-40d1-abd8-bcc953d61b7f') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-07821c.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%penicillin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-5f1e8d.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%penicillin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-e44134.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%penicillin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%powder%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-9426a2.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1810189') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-b24b44.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1810189') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-07a201.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1810189') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('sandoz', 'pharmacia upjohn')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-7c3f7b.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('sandoz', 'pharmacia upjohn', 'roerig') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%penicillin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-211155.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00049052022', '00781613595')
